title: Encrypted DNS Provisioning RFC 9464 Client Policy Work Item
summary: Add trace-owned client-side RFC 9464 encrypted DNS provisioning policy.
planned_changes:
- Add a pure client policy that consumes decoded ENCDNS_IP* and ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attributes.
- Prefer encrypted DNS resolvers over classic INTERNAL_IP*_DNS data when ENCDNS_IP* is available.
- Expand conveyed ENCDNS_IP* addresses into resolver session targets sorted by service priority.
- Route split-tunnel INTERNAL_DNS_DOMAIN names to encrypted resolvers when present.
- Reject ENCDNS_IP* data received after responder NULL authentication unless preconfigured.
- Model ADN and SHA2-256 SubjectPublicKeyInfo digest certificate validation outcomes and non-recoverable failure.
- Add focused positive and negative tests plus canonical xrefs.
verification_plan: Run the DNS project build, focused client-policy tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, QUIC requirement coverage triage generation, diff hygiene, and the full solution test before commit.
out_of_scope: Full IKEv2 Configuration Payload exchange processing.
TLS stack certificate chain construction or hostname matching.
Host OS resolver installation and split-tunnel route management.
completion_notes: The DNS adapter now has a trace-owned RFC 9464 client policy floor that can feed future IPsec/IKEv2 adapters and ProtocolLab scenarios.
